query:
SELECT empresaSlug, data, CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL) as cat9 FROM faturamentos WHERE data BETWEEN '2026-03-21' AND '2026-03-31' AND empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE','MORUMBI') ORDER BY empresaSlug, data;

SELECT empresaSlug, SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL)) as total, COUNT(*) as dias FROM faturamentos WHERE data LIKE '2026-03-%' AND empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE','MORUMBI') GROUP BY empresaSlug;
